title: Generalized outer-electron radii of neutral Coulomb atoms

abstractEnglish: We prove the radius part of the generalized ionization conjecture for neutral nonrelativistic Coulomb atoms with two spin states. For every choice of ground states, the upper and lower large-nuclear-charge limits of the radius defined by an expected exterior electron mass m are both asymptotic to $`(81\pi^2/2)^{1/3}m^{-1/3}`$ as m tends to infinity.
